metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the lovers, a voice kept under, and a search of the rushes.

yesterday: Nick stayed grave and low and held the dagger. Burbage kept his eyes on him.
The chair rose after a rustle and one cough.
A gold button set with five pearls was gone from her kirtle. Sam was half an hour on the floor.
Kemp's aside waits for the inn, down the river. You are still on the palace side of the walk to bed.
